newsitem.title: JAPAN: NTT down on U.S. phone licence postponement.
newsitem.headline: NTT down on U.S. phone licence postponement.

text.p: Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp (NTT) shares faltered in mid-morning Thursday trade, on the news that the granting of a U.S. licence to the company to provide international phone services would be delayed, brokers said.
As of 0138 GMT, the shares were down 4,000 yen at 816,000.
NTT said Wednesday that the U.S. Federal Communications Commission had informed NTT's U.S. unit that the granting of a U.S. licence to provide international phone services would be postponed.

The telecommunications giant said in late January that its wholly owned U.S. unit -- NTT America Inc -- had applied to the FCC for a licence to operate telecommunications services between the United States and other countries besides Japan.
